title: EventEnvelope
description: Canonical domain-event envelope containing identity, routing, causation, and schema metadata. Owner: platform/contracts. Event data payloads are carried in 'data' and must conform to a registered EVENT_DATA schema.

event_id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this event occurrence.

event_type.description: Fully-qualified event type including domain and schema version hint, e.g., billing.event.subscription-activated@v1.1.0

source.description: Service or component that produced the event.

subject.description: Entity identifier that is the subject of the event.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope for the event. Required for isolation.

billing_account_id.description: Billing account associated with the event, when applicable.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

schema_version.description: Exact schema version of the event data payload.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier linking related events and requests across services.

causation_id.description: Event ID that caused this event, if applicable.

data.description: Event data payload. Must conform to the schema declared by event_type and schema_version.
